//rawDir: Where scripts/screenshots.mjs writes its captures; {locale} is replaced per language.
//locales: Each locale needs a config/copy.<locale>.json and a capture folder. `dir` there drives RTL.
//slides: Order is the store order. `raw` is a filename in rawDir. `layout`: standard | full-bleed | angled | zoom. `zoom` needs `focus` (fractions of the raw image: x/y are the centre, scale is the magnification). `device`: iphone | pixel.
//targets: Exact export pixels. App Store Connect requires the "iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display)" slot (iPhone 6.1"/6.3"), which accepts only 1206x2622 or 1179x2556 portrait; the large 6.9"/6.5" slots are optional and scaled from it. So one target, one folder: screenshots/store/iphone-6.3/<locale>/. For Google Play add { "id": "play-phone", "store": "play", "width": 1080, "height": 1920, "scale": 3, "format": "jpeg", "quality": 92 } and a featureGraphic block (1024x500 JPEG, plus featureGraphic copy in every copy file).
